annual_excess_to_bvps.dependence: One annual event per November, no monthly repeats
annual_excess_to_bvps.forecast: Mean of earlier matured positive annual ratios
annual_excess_to_bvps.ordinary_rule: Median positive payments <=.25 in prior 24 months, fixed at November origin; no December information

support.reason: Sparse annual positive events are not independent monthly observations

annual_excess_to_bvps.target: Post-policy November origin: max(December-February cash minus ordinary quarter baseline fixed at November,0)/latest filed BVPS; conditional positive-event survivor endpoint
annual_excess_to_bvps.unit: December-February excess cash / November current BVPS

bvps_growth_12m.availability: Actual filing date of the exact future report
bvps_growth_12m.forecast: Mean of earlier labels matured by origin

support.reason: Fixed control; model evidence requires strict chronological folds

bvps_growth_12m.target: Latest filed report at origin to that report month +12; future/current BVPS minus one
bvps_growth_12m.unit: fractional BVPS growth on the origin share basis

cash_dividend_12m.forecast: Cash in the past 12 calendar months, origin basis

support.reason: Fixed control; model evidence requires strict chronological folds

cash_dividend_12m.unit: USD cash per one origin-date PGR share

pgr_drip_return_6m.forecast: Mean of earlier matured PGR DRIP return labels

support.reason: Fixed control; model evidence requires strict chronological folds

pgr_drip_return_6m.target: One raw origin share, manual splits and fractional ex-date DRIP to business month-end +6M; unbenchmarked absolute asset return, never absolute-value magnitude
pgr_drip_return_6m.unit: signed fractional total return of PGR alone
